item.toxicsporedsc: A collection of spores from a fungus. Try not to breathe it in too much.
item.toxicresindsc: A sticky, goopy yellow resin. Might be useful for crafting.
item.toxicfiberdsc: A thin, spindly natural material, strengthened through years of fending off predators. Could be useful for crafting.
item.toxicoredsc: Of all the rocks you shouldn't put in your mouth, this is the one you should put there least of all.
item.slimechunkdsc: A glob of green slime. Sadly, it doesn't feel great to poke anymore. Must have lost its slime juice...
item.gringlevinebulbdsc: A bulb torn from a Gringlevine. Contains a bioluminescent material that glows on its own within. <color=#FF2E51>Pressed into a wound it burns, but cleans it and draws out toxins.</color>
item.algaegreendsc: An overgrown lump of living algae, adapted to the toxic enviroment.
item.glaucosaltcrystaldsc: A shard of condensed toxic acid, undergone crystallization.
item.embrasharddsc: The crystallized remains of what once was.
item.radioactiveoredsc: Makes you feel warm and tingly at the touch. Probably best to tuck this in a bag.
item.endomorphicjellydsc: ...is it staring at you? No, it's staring at your items. Drag onto an item to do... something.
item.agaranichordsc: So much plant, yet so little ichor. Fluid hard-won from reluctant blooms.
item.pulsecrystaldsc: A perfect translucent node on the wall, almost unnatural.
item.pulsecoredsc:
A biological power core, though you do not know how it works. Could be used to power all electronics. Seemingly has twice as much charge as a medium battery.
It should be fine to use, right?
item.bioluminescentgeldsc: A gelatinous material, somewhere between liquid and solid, that passively gives off light. Easily adheres to other surfaces. If your dream in life was to become a walking lantern, look no further!
item.toxicpoulticedsc: It's cold, slimy, and mushy. Theoretically, it should use the layer flora's biological adaptations to rid yourself of minor toxicity.
item.wrapvinebandagedsc: A more refined tonguewrap. This should be very good for stopping external bleeding.
item.sporefilterdsc: A mesh film that allows airs through. And aerosols, not so much.
item.slimemealdsc: You can't say it's the most appetising thing you've considered eating, but it does have some definitive nutritional value. Stretchy food!
item.pulselanterndsc: What better then to harness the power of the toxic alien crystal by putting it into a container and have it light your way?
item.tonguewrapdsc: It's clingy, sticks to your skin, and holds well. Should work as an exceptional makeshift bandage.
item.bugrepellantmushdsc: A foul-smelling mush that keeps cave ticks far away. This seems useful.
item.bloodgumdsc: A pustule of flesh taken from a Bloodgum Tree. It's still bleeding from where you picked it off. <color=#FF2E51>Pressed into a wound it keeps closing the skin and keeps it clean.</color>
item.vitreouseyedsc: An eye torn from a stalk, presumably much larger than your own. It still feels like it's looking at you... <color=#FF2E51>Graft it into your head to replace an eye you have lost.</color>
item.hemostaticassimilatordsc: An organelle that tries to patch together the wounds of whatever it's attached to. <color=#FF2E51>Permanently increases natural regeneration when used.</color>
item.infinitesteakdsc: A continuously growing chunk of raw meat. Good as an emergency food source, but sickening if eaten too often.
item.bloodvinecordagedsc: A loop of rapidly-unfurling bloodvine. Extended placement range, but must be placed on the underside of tiles.
item.carminehanddrilldsc: It runs on blood, and it takes blood out of whatever it cuts. Drag onto your wounds to ""Cauterize"" them.
item.hematiteweaverdsc: A ring of living tissue with a piece of metal caught in the middle of it, still nurtured by flesh. <color=#FF2E51>Infinitely creates scrap metal.</color>
item.activatedpulsecoredsc: A self-recharging pulse core... surely nothing bad will happen..?
item.bloodtendrildsc: A vein torn loose, coiling around and sticking to your claws. It would hold a wound shut.
item.thoxithornfangdsc: A tooth picked from the ground. Unnervingly sharp.
item.bloodstonedsc: Bile and pus hardened onto the end of a tendril. Cold and heavier than it looks.
item.polishedplatedsc: A polished plate of calcite material. Strong and smooth to the touch.
item.thornslingerdsc: A firearm made from combined flesh and metal. Functions differently depending on the type of ammo slotted into it.
item.carminematerialpouchdsc: A materials pouch made from a fleshy growth. Can hold more than it used to, but lasts considerably less.
item.carminebackpackdsc: A backpack made from a fleshy material...your supplies seem to decay slower in it.
item.viscerachunkdsc: A lump of the layer's own tissue. Edible, but...
item.viscerameatdsc: Hunger is the best spice. ...It doesn't rot, even in your inventory.
item.ancientmatterdsc: A cold and unnatural dense nodule. It does not feel like the flesh around it. <color=#FF2E51>Swallowing it makes the world forget how much of you it knows.</color>

moodle.toxicpoison1dsc: Something has gotten into your body that shouldn't be there. You feel weird and sick.
moodle.toxicpoison2dsc: Something is horribly wrong on the inside. Nausea is quickly growing; you feel sluggish.
moodle.toxicpoison3dsc: Green floods your vision. Your organs are shutting down. Death is imminent.
moodle.toxicpoison4dsc: The book was page-to-page arsenic - a terrible read for people who lick their finger before turning the page.
moodle.bugrepellentdsc: Cave ticks avoid your scent. Traders also avoid your scent...
moodle.bioluminescentgeldsc: Your very skin emits a bright light, illuminating the caves around you.
moodle.visceraedigestion1dsc: The layer has started gnawing away at your skin.
moodle.visceraedigestion2dsc: Your blood weeps from where the flesh touched you; your skin will not heal like it normally does.
moodle.visceraedigestion3dsc: You are becoming soup. There is not much time left.
moodle.visceraeparasite1dsc: Something is living inside you. You feel a faint, persistent hunger.
moodle.visceraeparasite2dsc: Something is feeding inside you. You feel a stronger, more persistent hunger.
moodle.visceraeparasite3dsc: You are getting consumed from the inside-out.
moodle.visceraeparasite4dsc: You are not sure who is feeding whom any more.
moodle.visceraeassimilation1dsc: Something about this place draws you in...
moodle.visceraeassimilation2dsc: The longer you stay, the more it pulls on you.
moodle.visceraeassimilation4dsc: You feel as if you are part of the layer.
moodle.visceraebloodbubbledsc: On the inside of the bubble, everything looks red. On the outside, you look horrifying. <color=lightblue>The first instance of external damage against you will be fully blocked.</color>

building.pulsecrystalnodedsc: A living crystal that pulses with toxic light.
building.toxicpinkbloomdsc: Massive size, vibrant colors, rooting in the toxic soil... ...this plant is harmless?
building.slimebushdsc: Moist, squelchy, and bulbous. It feels nice to poke.
building.embrashardclusterdsc: A green crystal cluster. It's shiny.
building.lumivinedsc: A luminous vine hanging from the ceiling. Seems too fragile to be climbed.
building.tonguebushdsc: The humans back in the labs said you couldn't have any liquor; maybe you can have licker instead.
building.gringlevinedsc: A glowing vine hanging from the cavern ceiling. Seems sturdy enough.
building.elderwallstridermiddledsc: Abdomen of the elder wall strider. Houses ticks seeking vengeance for all living things.
building.elderwallstriderlowerdsc: Tail of the elder wall strider. Spawns ticks to help aid against its prey.
building.elderwallstriderupperhorndsc: Upper horn of the elder wall strider. Many an elder thornback has fallen to it.
building.elderwallstriderlowerhorndsc: Lower horn of the elder wall strider. No barricade can stand in its way.
building.thornitoxseeddsc: Teeth that grow out of the crimson landscape in a gruesome imitation of flora.
building.mawflowerdsc: Despite the name, it is not a flower. It will munch on you if you get too close.
building.bloodstoneplantdsc: Bile and pus have seemingly coalesced into the ends of tendrils, hard as a rock.
building.veincurtaindsc: A fleshy tendril sprouting out from the ground.
building.eyestalkdsc: An eye growing up out of the ground from a fleshy stalk. It's looking around at anything near it.
building.bilebladderdsc: An exposed node, one that continuously oozes bile from its pores.
building.clawnestdsc: A gathering of rot and decay. While it normally feeds on the fleshy terrain, it won't hesitate to feed on your flesh either.
building.bloodvinedsc: A collection of arteries, coiled together in a crude imitation of flora.
building.atropuseyedsc: A swollen eye on a stalk of nerves. Close up, you are the only thing worth looking at, and it would like a closer look.
building.bloodgumtreedsc: Gnarled and leaning, a bubble of blood accumulates above.
building.bloodbubbledsc: A bubble made from a thin film of blood, lighter than air. It seems like you could go in it if you tried...
building.lasertrapdsc: An emitter of some forgotten make. It's still warm, and very much still deadly.
building.mawdsc: A sentient vine, launnching hooked tendrils at whatever it can see. Luckily, you're too large to be eaten whole.
building.mawtendrildsc: A tendril of flesh, all too eager to drain blood.
building.galltreedsc: A large trunk of flesh and pustules.
building.eyestalkgazedsc: An eye growing up out of the ground from a fleshy stalk. It's looking at <color=red>you</color>.

other.homeopathicantivenomdsc: A handmade, plant-based antivenom substitute. It's nearly as effective as the original, though your immune cells might not have the highest opinions of it.
other.toxicaciddsc: It's toxic, and it's acid. You probably want to avoid touching it, if possible.
other.toxicentermask: Good thing I have a dust mask for this.
other.cauterizedlimbdsc: Your wounds are scabbed over by a film of protective charred blood, and will not bleed for {time}.
other.carminebitedsc: Your {limb} is being eaten away to sustain a piece of equipment.
other.toxicenter2: Are those toxic fumes in the air?
other.toxicexit1: I never want to see a cave tick again.
other.toxicexit3: My sense of smell is all fuzzy now
other.visceraeenter2: Great, I'm now in some living thing
other.visceraeenter3: Hopefully this place doesn't find me tasty...
other.visceraeexit3: Get me out of this place
other.bilefluiddsc: Bitter, acidic, and unnervingly yellow. It smells of decay...
other.venousblooddsc: Viscous and thick. What a strange color for blood...
other.arthroplastsdsc: A thick, iridescent fluid. It seems to be able to mend bones.
other.gamesetnewdescents.debug.startlayerdsc: Starts your run off at a chosen layer, with weighted random equipment and stats.
other.gamesetnewdescents.debug.autolaunchdsc: Skips the menu and launches straight into the chosen start layer when the game loads.
other.gamesetnewdescents.effectsqualitydsc: God rays, fog, floating motes and Old Machinery sparks. Lowering this may help GPU performance.
